title: agentPane.widgets settings, version 1
description: The widget-wide settings keys (cmux.json keys under agentPane.widgets.*). The `default` of each key is the only place that states the default. The Swift settings descriptor for the key must use this value, so a default change is one edit here plus the matching descriptor value.

agentPane.widgets.code.description: Code widgets (cmux.html). off: the pane does not run them; it shows the title, Show source and Open as file. on: the pane runs them in the widget sandbox. Data widgets and built-in cards render in both modes. MDM can pin this key.
agentPane.widgets.code.$comment: Default off until the W4 and W5 isolation tests pass on the fleet (coordinator condition, 2026-10-06). Then the default changes to on here.
